kurz: Butter forms when you whip cream until the fat droplets stick together. What is left is buttermilk.
bild_im_kopf: Like a crowd gathering into little groups after a concert: many individuals become a few big clumps.
ergebnis: About 200 g of butter and a good 250 ml of buttermilk from 500 ml of cream (as a guide).
haltbarkeit: About a week if washed well and chilled, longer if salted. A few months frozen.
material: pinch of salt if you like
verwendung: The buttermilk for pancakes or Zopf.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Whip cold cream past the whipped-cream stage
schluesselmomente.warum: First, whipping traps air. Then the shells of the fat droplets tear and the fat starts to clump.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Keep whipping until it suddenly splashes
schluesselmomente.warum: The [[emulsion|emulsion]] flips: fat in water becomes a lump of fat, and buttermilk separates off.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Pour off and keep the buttermilk
schluesselmomente.warum: It is the watery phase, with milk protein and milk sugar.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Knead the butter in iced water until the water stays clear
schluesselmomente.warum: Leftover buttermilk would quickly turn sour and spoil the [[butter|butter]].

schluesselmomente.schritt: Salt and shape as you like
schluesselmomente.warum: Salt seasons and makes the butter keep longer.
